# Archived page-load measurements — 2026-11-09 development runs

These are the 84 rows that were in `od_metrics_1` before it was cleared on
2026-11-09, so the public medians start from real visits only.

## Why they were cleared

- **All rows are from development and test runs**, not real visitors: one
  Chrome 156 on macOS, driven by an automation harness.
- **The JS heap figures are inflated.** The harness navigated a single tab from
  editor to editor. Chrome reuses the renderer process for same-site
  navigations, and `performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize` reports that process's
  heap, so each page inherited garbage from the previous editors. The heap
  climbs from ~54 MB (first page in the tab) to ~150 MB regardless of the
  editor; e.g. folio was measured at both 21 MB (fresh tab, row 65) and 139 MB.
  Only a page opened in a fresh tab gives a fair heap number.
- `office-open` has since been removed from the bench (it has no editing
  surface).
- Startup times include several cold CDN fetches while the editors were being
  fixed (e.g. canvas-editor 5.2 s, row 81).

(same-origin or `Timing-Allow-Origin`), so it is the most stable of the three.
